field_definitions.CERTMTH: FY2017 Tech Doc pp. 55, 59: reviewer-recorded months in current certification or recertification period
field_definitions.LASTCERT: FY2017 Tech Doc pp. 55, 59: constructed months since last SNAP certification
field_definitions.loader: snap_qc_sim/data.py load_cases does not expose either field

certification_vintage_split.limitation: Month arithmetic supports a recorded-certification vintage split, not direct identification of conversion status.
certification_vintage_split.method: YRMONTH minus integer LASTCERT months; CERTMTH is period length and does not date certification

element_mix.unit: strict-coded Rhode Island error cases; case-level code presence
